title: Donut
description: Shows how a whole splits into up to six parts, with the total in the middle and each part's share beside it.
x-use-when: Part-to-whole for one total split into 2 to 6 parts: revenue mix by category, open order lines by item class, Commercial vs SLED split.
x-dont-use-when: The parts don't add up to a meaningful whole, or you are comparing values across categories (use bar_chart), there are more than 6 parts (group the smallest into "Other", or use bar_chart), or the split changes over time (use line_chart or a stacked bar_chart).
x-checks: Error when two slices share a label.
Warns when the values add up to 1 (they look like shares; pass the raw amounts).
Warns when slices aren't sorted largest first (a slice named "Other" may come last).

slices.description: The parts of the whole, largest first. Group anything past the fifth part into a final "Other" slice.

value.description: The part's raw amount (count or dollars), not its share. The donut computes shares from the total.

format.description: How the total and slice values are displayed. Shares are always shown as percents.

center_label.description: Short label under the total in the middle of the donut, e.g. "Open lines". Default: "Total".
